{{Short description|Chinese chemist and chemical engineer}}
{{family name hatnote|[[Yang (surname)|Yang]]|lang=Chinese}}
'''Yang Guanghua''' or '''Guang-Hwa Yang''' ({{zh|s=杨光华}}; 1923–2006), was a Chinese chemist and [[Chemical engineering|chemical engineer]]. He was the President of [[China University of Petroleum (Beijing)|China University of Petroleum]], and a pioneer of [[Oil in China|China's oil industry]].<ref name="MPC-object" />

== Biography ==
Yang was born in [[Liuyang]], [[Hunan]], on 10 April 1923. In 1945, he graduated from the Department of Chemical Engineering of [[Zhejiang University]] in [[Hangzhou]]. He was a [[teaching assistant]] in the same department. In 1948, Yang went to study in the [[United States]], and obtained his [[Doctor of Engineering]] degree from the [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]] in 1951.{{Citation needed|date=October 2020}} 

Yang went back to China in May 1951. Yang was a professor at [[Peking University]] and [[Tsinghua University]]. In 1953, Yang joined to found the Beijing Petroleum College (北京石油学院; predecessor of current China University of Petroleum). In 1956, Yang was a [[visiting researcher]] at Moscow Petroleum Institute, [[USSR]]. In 1965, Yang was pointed Vice-president of Beijing Petroleum College. After 1969, Yang was Vice-president, later President of East China Petroleum College ({{lang|zh-Hans|华东石油学院}}). From 1988 to 1992, Yang was the President of China University of Petroleum (CUP), a [[national key university]]. Yang died in [[Beijing]] on 11 November 2006 at age 83. Yang donated his books and academic collections to the library of CUP.<ref>[http://www.heavyoil.cn/news/book2007-5-22654.htm 杨光华教授生前一批图书捐赠我校]</ref>

In the 1950s, Yang and Prof. Wu Chi ({{lang|zh|武迟}}) co-founded the first educational program of oil and [[natural gas]] engineering/[[refining]] in China.

Yang's son [[Yang Wei (Zhejiang University)|Yang Wei]], a [[mechanical engineering|mechanical engineer]], served as [[Presidents of Zhejiang University|President of Zhejiang University]].<ref>[[Hong Kong]] [[Wen Wei Po]]: [http://trans.wenweipo.com/gb/paper.wenweipo.com/2007/05/28/CB0705280001.htm 从知青到院士杨卫 引领浙大创一流] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090417123808/http://trans.wenweipo.com/gb/paper.wenweipo.com/2007/05/28/CB0705280001.htm |date=2009-04-17 }}</ref>

== Honors ==
Asteroid [[10410 Yangguanghua]], discovered by the [[Beijing Schmidt CCD Asteroid Program]] in 1997, is named in his memory.<ref name="MPC-object" /> The official {{MoMP|10410|naming citation}} was published by the [[Minor Planet Center]] on 26 October 2018 ({{small|[[Minor Planet Circulars|M.P.C.]] 112427}}).<ref name="MPC-Circulars-Archive" />
